problem_title: The conjectured extension of the Burnside–Stirling–Gautschi bound

evidence.text:
Schmidlin Conjecture 37 holds strictly for every nonnegative base point and, more generally, every nonnegative interpolation parameter. A classical Stirling remainder bound, logarithmic entropy estimate and translated positive-discriminant certificate prove the comparison. The literal gamma-function expression, source domain and all supporting inequalities are proved in Lean.See full solutionHide full solutionSchmidlin Conjecture 37 holds strictly for every nonnegative base point and, more generally, every nonnegative interpolation parameter.
